rules.identity: Identify each document by its CONTENT (title page), never by its file name; the file names KUHP*.pdf are misleading
rules.normalise: join hyphenated line breaks then collapse whitespace (see normalise())
rules.dedupe: Exclude byte-identical duplicates (same SHA-256) from the index
rules.chunks: One chunk per Pasal (body) + one chunk per Pasal in PENJELASAN + one chunk per page as fallback; every chunk carries doc_id, pasal (if known), page
rules.ocr: UU 20/2025 is a scanned copy with an OCR layer: use OCR-tolerant heading regex; where a heading is not detected, cite the page only and offer 'Lihat halaman asli'
